theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Don't Mean Permanent Loss
body: Volatility is normal. Short-term ups and downs aren't actual losses unless you sell during dips. Stay calm, stay invested.
caption: Markets fluctuate, but panic selling locks in losses unnecessarily. Understanding that temporary downturns are part of long-term investing helps you avoid costly emotional decisions. #BehaviouralFinance #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #InvestingMindset #LongTermWealth
